checks.name: Solver finished without errors
checks.meaning: A blow-up means the time step is too large for the flow speed or the viscous limit.

checks.name: No NaN values
checks.meaning: NaN (not a number) means invalid values.

checks.name: Max Courant number
checks.meaning: Fluid should not cross more than about one cell per time step (limit used: 1).

checks.name: Divergence after projection
checks.meaning: max |div u| h / U after each step: the velocity must stay divergence-free (mass conservation).
